statements.quote: Our generative AI book of business now stands at more than $12.5 billion.
statements.notes: 'More than $12.5 billion' recorded as a floor of $12.5B. 'Book of business' is IBM's cumulative measure of generative AI bookings and software sales since inception, not revenue recognized in fiscal 2025; treat with caution as a revenue figure. No year is named (present tense), so the fiscal year defaults to the reported year.
